$comment: The committed registry of ALWAYS-ON agent routines (role-lens review, ai-ops next-work). Every recurring scheduled lane is declared here with its cadence, the human who authorized it, what it may write, where it stops and escalates, and where its firing evidence lands. scripts/check-scheduled-routines.mjs holds this file against the heartbeat artifacts and the org roster; its header states honestly that it gates the DECLARATION and the EVIDENCE OF FIRING — it cannot read the live account scheduler. Transcribed FROM the live scheduler (list_triggers) on 2026-08-21, not from memory. One-shot self-reminders (send_later check-ins) are deliberately out of scope: they are ephemeral work-pacing, not standing lanes.
transcribedFrom: live scheduler, 2026-09-05 (re-transcribed on moving mac-lane-steward-duty-cycle to hourly and both self-session routines onto lane-deliver; mac-lane-tick added the same day — it is a launchd agent on the owner's Mac, not an account trigger, so it is declared from scripts/mac/install-launchd.sh rather than from list_triggers; earlier: 2026-08-21; 2026-09-13: the brain-cycle account trigger was created then deleted — list_triggers confirms none exists — and its row is kept awaiting-activation; 2026-09-13 (later): forward-build-cycle added as an ACTIVE self-session routine (trig_01XLv3hGCPob8qcEDsZJ2xM8) per the owner's explicit go to build the company forward continuously; the second brain-cycle trigger created that day was deleted again, so list_triggers still shows no brain-cycle trigger); 2026-10-09: the brain-cycle row retired at the registry's 30-day awaiting-activation bound — list_triggers still shows no brain-cycle trigger (none had existed since 2026-09-13)

routines.authorizationEvidence: owner message in-session: 'Can you have an employee monitor and administrator for the Mac lane please' — the role was created in direct response, same day. Cadence 4h -> hourly on 2026-09-05, owner message: 'Need you to have a better system with local Mac lane cause this is not working and causing delay'. Delivery made EVENT-DRIVEN + KEEPALIVE on 2026-09-23 (owner decision): a heartbeat PR is delivered only on a NON-QUIET cycle (real Mac activity, a new/moved mac/* branch, a sim result, mail to ack, manifest drift, or an action taken) OR when the last heartbeat is >2h old (a time-based keepalive under the 3h cadenceToleranceHours); a quiet cycle within tolerance delivers nothing. The hourly WAKE (cron 24 * * *) is unchanged so new mac/* branches and mail are still reviewed within the hour. Owner directive 2026-09-23 ('build something that monitors the raise your hand function then apply what is needed for the agents to address or create new agent and or skill to fill that gap regardless if it's for any lane'): each cycle also runs the raised-hands skill — dispatch the blocker-dispatcher agent for the cloud lane, execute its dispatch plan, clear what was resolved, raise covering hands for the Mac's, bundle overdue owner hands once — and checks the raised-hands issue is fresh (<2h), re-running raised-hands.yml if not. Raise/clear/take ops ride the cycle's one lane:deliver batch.
routines.writeScope: artifacts/lane-messages/**, artifacts/raised-hands/** (the hands it raises, takes and clears — covering hands for the Mac's stalls and owner hands for PRs only the owner can land) and artifacts/agent-heartbeats/mac-lane-steward-duty-cycle.json, delivered through scripts/lane-deliver.mjs onto a lane/cloud-mail-* branch that is opened as a PR and auto-merged — NEVER through the code branch (that is what held acks behind open code PRs). Plus: opens a draft PR for every unmerged origin/mac/* branch, subscribes to it, reviews and lands it. Since 2026-09-06 it also carries the duties absorbed from the retired live-sync-loop-keeper: checks pending sim-requests (scripts/check-sim-requests.mjs), unread lane messages (scripts/check-lane-messages.mjs), and the age of artifacts/live-evidence/mac-run.json — when that file is >3 days stale it mails the Mac lane through lane:deliver.
routines.escalationBoundary: escalates to the owner ONLY what only the owner can clear (credentials, Mac-side actions); a quiet cycle produces no owner message. Live-evidence staleness (artifacts/live-evidence/mac-run.json older than 3 days) goes to the Mac lane as lane mail, never to the owner.

Zero deliveries is not a quiet routine; it is a routine that never had a write path. Its duties are absorbed by mac-lane-steward-duty-cycle: pending sim-requests, unread lane messages, and artifacts/live-evidence/mac-run.json staleness (>3 days) -> Mac-lane mail, never an owner message.

This 2026-09-09 message authorizes BUILDING the machinery (Slice 1, dormant). ACTIVATION was subsequently authorized by the owner on 2026-09-13 ('Activate it now'), so no further owner consent is pending; what remains before the trigger is created is the registry-first sequence (land the active row on SignalGrid_Alpha, prove a Slice-2 dry run, then create_trigger) per the awaiting-activation contract and DR-032 — a technical prerequisite, not an owner gate.
routines.writeScope: artifacts/brain-cycle/** (the per-cycle audit blackboard), artifacts/lane-messages/** and artifacts/agent-heartbeats/brain-cycle.json (heartbeat via scripts/lane-deliver.mjs onto a lane/cloud-mail-* branch, never the code branch); opens DRAFT PRs for winning autonomous-tier routes only (classifyDiff==autonomous). Never auto-merges; never opens a PR touching SAFETY_MACHINERY or OWNER_RESERVED surfaces (those escalate).
routines.escalationBoundary: escalates to the owner every owner-gated route, every tie, and every unrecognised/ambiguous tier; auto-OPEN (draft) is the ceiling and auto-MERGE is off (owner GREEN switch in docs/agent/brain-cycle-config.json, default false). Fail-closed halts (not ships): a stale brain (check-brain-freshness), an absent or ran:false expected lens, or an unverifiable surface stops the cycle.
routines.awaitingReason: Machinery ready and owner-authorized (2026-09-09, re-affirmed 2026-09-13 'Activate it now'). A same-session activation on 2026-09-13 was REVERTED (trigger deleted): it created the trigger BEFORE this active row reached SignalGrid_Alpha (a fire could not heartbeat — check-scheduled-routines fatals on a heartbeat for an awaiting routine) and before the dispatch->gauntlet->PR path was proven end-to-end. Re-activation follows the design order: land this row active on Alpha, prove a Slice-2 dry run, THEN create_trigger (DR-032; Codex #705). Activation is NOT yet mechanically landable and is Slice-3 ENGINEERING, not a runbook (BRAIN_CYCLE_DESIGN.md Slice 3): authorizedOn (2026-09-09) doubles as the gate's active-no-heartbeat clock, so a bare flip to active is already past the 168h bound (needs a gate activatedOn baseline, a scripts/** change); and lane-deliver writes only the heartbeat artifact and runs check-scheduled-routines PRE-commit without staging this file, while the gate FATALs on awaiting-activation + a heartbeat, so the first fire cannot atomically land its heartbeat and flip status (needs a dedicated activation path, not lane-deliver). create_trigger must still come AFTER the row and a proven Slice-2 dry run (registry-first). Until that Slice-3 code exists the row stays awaiting-activation, authorizedOn is NEVER overwritten (the 2026-09-13 go is in authorizationEvidence), and no trigger is created. awaitingSince (2026-09-09) is the watchdog baseline and is NOT reset to dodge the 30-day bound: if the bound is reached before activation lands, ACTIVATE, RETIRE the row with evidence, or ESCALATE — never restart the clock (DR-032; Codex #705, #708).
routines.retiredBy: cloud lane (forward-build fire 00:10Z, 2026-10-09; the registry's own 30-day bound tripped at this fire)
routines.retiredReason: Awaiting activation for 30 days with the activation prerequisite never met: the registry-first sequence required a Slice-2 dry run proven end-to-end before create_trigger, and no such run was ever recorded. Trigger history, stated in full: a self-session trigger for this row WAS created on 2026-09-13 at 02:11Z, out of the registry-first order, on the branch of PR #705 (closed, never merged) and deleted on that branch the same day at 02:40Z per Codex #705; a second brain-cycle trigger created later that day was deleted again (transcribedFrom, 2026-09-13). Mainline's record of the reversal is PR #708 (merge 6bd453d6, 2026-09-13T10:52Z, 'keep dormant … supersedes #705'), which kept the dead trigger id off mainline by design, so the id is not repeated here. No fire from either trigger ever reached the tree, and the account scheduler lists no brain-cycle trigger now, disabled ones included. The declared heartbeat path and the artifacts/brain-cycle blackboard have never been written (evidence below). The standing operation the owner authorized on 2026-09-09 and 2026-09-13 has been performed by forward-build-cycle (trig_01XLv3hGCPob8qcEDsZJ2xM8): daily at 15:00Z from its first heartbeat commit on 2026-09-14T15:24Z, every two hours since the owner's choice on 2026-09-29, with gaps. The longest, 130.4 hours, has no forward-build heartbeat commit between 2026-10-03T00:09Z and 2026-10-08T10:32Z; six earlier spans exceed 24 hours (24.8, 45.0, 28.5, 47.4, 54.7 and 24.2 hours, by commit time on a full clone). Forward-build keeps a wave of worker sessions building the backlog and lands code PRs after an adversarial review (a Sonnet reviewer plus an Opus refuter, the tiers DR-047 assigns; the pairing is the routine prompt's own rule, which gives a MECHANICAL docs-only PR the Sonnet review plus the CI docs gates and merges a heartbeat PR on the gating check alone), which is the 'security and code check validation for bugs' this row described, at a higher cadence; whether that equals the DR-032 lens-panel audit over a blackboard is this lane's judgment call, recorded here. Retiring the row records those facts instead of carrying a label past the bound the gate holds. The owner's activation consent of 2026-09-13 stands in authorizationEvidence; awaitingReason and awaitingSince are kept as the record of the wait and are inert for a retired row (the gate reads them only while status is awaiting-activation). A daily audit blackboard remains buildable as a NEW row (the prerequisite dry run still required) if the owner wants it beside the two-hourly cycle.

routines.trigger: awaiting-activation — no account trigger yet; a fresh-session-per-fire trigger is created via create_trigger only AFTER an EXPLICIT owner go for this cadence (no consent is inferred from a build/evaluation directive, exactly as the brain-cycle row requires). Neither the cloud lane nor any persistent session may self-authorize creating the account trigger. Not yet a trig_*.
routines.authorizationEvidence: The owner asked for the 2026-09-12 organization self-evaluation ('make sure everything in this project is being worked on and has eyes on it ... through the proper channels'); its pipes reader found ten Dependabot PRs (#352-#361) open 11 days with CI never run and 'no roster role, routine, backlog row or LOOP line owns the monthly queue' (docs/agent/ORG_SELF_EVALUATION_2026-09-12.md row 6), and named the fix as 'roster row for the monthly queue'. This record-hygiene pass (docs/agent/EVIDENCE.md, 2026-09-12) executes exactly that named fix. `.github/dependabot.yml` sets `schedule.interval: monthly` for both its npm ecosystem groups, so the underlying QUEUE this routine watches is monthly and already running on GitHub; the CRON here is the CHECK cadence, and it is weekly rather than monthly on purpose — see the cron note below.
routines.writeScope: Its only repository write is its own heartbeat at `artifacts/agent-heartbeats/dependabot-queue-review.json` each cycle; it has NO merge authority and no other write scope — it REVIEWS and TRIAGES Dependabot's own PRs and ESCALATES every merge to the owner; it never auto-merges. Dependabot PRs change `package.json`/`pnpm-lock.yaml`, which `check-owner-gated-surfaces.mjs` treats as safety-machinery-adjacent, so the merge stays an owner decision regardless of green CI. It never edits `.github/dependabot.yml`, `pnpm-lock.yaml` by hand outside a Dependabot PR, or any file `check-owner-gated-surfaces.mjs` classifies SAFETY_MACHINERY/OWNER_RESERVED. Owned by the `devex-tooling-engineer` role (docs/agent/org-roster.json, docs/ORG_CHART.md:91): 'A gate changes, or one is suspected of passing vacuously' already covers a lockfile-changing PR; this row adds the recurring queue-check that role was missing.
routines.escalationBoundary: Escalates to the owner only for a major-version Dependabot PR that needs code changes to pass, or a run stuck in `action_required` needing the owner's one-time workflow approval (docs/OWNER_ACTIONS.md); a quiet week with nothing new and no PR older than its tolerance sends no owner message. It never merges any Dependabot PR itself, green or not — every merge is escalated to the owner.
routines.heartbeatPathReason: When active, the routine writes a heartbeat to this path each review cycle so a silent stop (a disabled trigger or a dead session) is distinguishable from a quiet successful week with nothing to review — a silent absence is not. No heartbeat file exists yet because the routine is still awaiting-activation.
routines.awaitingReason: Declared in this pass to close the gap the 2026-09-12 self-evaluation found; the account trigger is deliberately not created here because creating a recurring fresh-session cadence requires an EXPLICIT owner go (no consent is inferred from a build/evaluation directive), per the awaiting-activation contract this registry already uses for brain-cycle. Neither the cloud lane nor a persistent session may self-authorize it.
routines.cronNote: Dependabot's own schedule is `.github/dependabot.yml`'s `interval: monthly` — this registry's `cronIntervalHours` (scripts/check-scheduled-routines.mjs) can only read every-N-minutes, hourly, every-N-hours, daily, or weekly-single-weekday shapes; it has no monthly primitive, and an unparseable cron on a non-retired routine fails this gate's own self-test floor. So the cron above is WEEKLY (Monday 09:00 UTC), not monthly: it checks the monthly-generated queue often enough that an open PR is never unreviewed for the 11 days the self-evaluation found, which is a tighter bound than monthly would give and the one the finding actually calls for.

routines.authorizationEvidence: owner message in-session 2026-09-13: 'I want you to continue to always have everyone building the company ... the system aka brain keeps everything running no matter what I'm currently chatting with you or ask you do something else.' This is an explicit go for STANDING autonomous operation (not a per-feature build directive), so a self-session cloud trigger (trig_01XLv3hGCPob8qcEDsZJ2xM8) was created the same day; self-session so it inherits the operating session's push + GitHub-PR + merge path — the capability the retired fresh-session nightly-build-agent (trig_01WaoZcckmBjv5Pqs8hGNhFS) never had. Registry-first order: this active row lands on SignalGrid_Alpha well before the trigger's first fire (2026-09-14T15:00Z). 2026-09-29: the owner asked in-session why the brain was not building ("Please build the whole system using the brain why isn't this happening as I expected") and chose "Every 2h, whole backlog" when offered daily/every-2h/every-6h — so this routine now fires every two hours (10 */2 * * *, re-transcribed from the live scheduler after update_trigger) and works the whole cloud-buildable backlog, not only tasks[0..2].
routines.writeScope: claude/build-* code branches (ONE bounded product item per fire, opened as a PR to SignalGrid_Alpha for OWNER review/merge — the harness structurally blocks agent self-merge of product PRs), docs/BUILD_BACKLOG.md item status via that PR — and, since 2026-09-24 (DR-056), the item it picks is READ from docs/agent/objective-state.json tasks[0..2] first (the ranked company queue from docs/COMPANY_BUILD_PLAN.md "## Global backlog", resolved to real executors) and, since 2026-09-29 (owner: "whole backlog"), when none of those is cloud-buildable it takes the next open Global-backlog row this lane can build end to end (no live lab, no Swift toolchain or device, no owner decision, not already an open PR) instead of heartbeating quiet; the recorded verdict is trusted only while the mac-lane-tick heartbeat (artifacts/agent-heartbeats/mac-lane-tick.json) is within the state's staleAfterHours AND names that verdict — otherwise the state reads unknown and the fire escalates instead of building on it; it may groom either backlog document by PR and the next Mac tick re-derives; it never writes the state file, and artifacts/agent-heartbeats/forward-build-cycle.json (heartbeat via scripts/lane-deliver.mjs onto a lane/cloud-mail-* branch, never the code branch). A purely autonomous-tier gate/doc/fossil-figure fix may self-merge under DR-037; it NEVER self-merges a product / launch-profile / launch-claims-gate / publication-boundary change.
routines.escalationBoundary: escalates to the owner only a genuine product decision (a new vertical / platform / hardware surface = DR-020) or a physical action he alone can take; a fire with nothing cleanly actionable builds nothing and heartbeats 'quiet' — no owner message. Runs in the operating session, so every fire is owner-supervisable.
